en.title: Minimum Cost of Deleting Pairs of Equal and Different Characters
en.description:
Each time, choose any two positions and delete them; the cost is x if the characters are equal and y otherwise. Given a string of even length, find the minimum total cost to delete everything.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains the string dataset (even length 2..100000), and the second line contains x y (1..10000).
en.explanation: Example 1: the four a characters must form at least one pair among themselves, and the other two pairs are mixed, for a total of 3+2+2=7. Example 2: pair oo and ui, for a total of 2+4=6. Example 3: delete aa and bb separately, at a cost of 4.
hints: If same-character pairs are cheaper, make as many of them as possible, which is the sum of each frequency divided by 2 (integer division); if mixed pairs are cheaper, only max(0,(maximum frequency)−n/2) same-character pairs are forced, and all others are mixed.
